verdict.rationale: llamafile supports the standard GGUF format (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi), which suggests the same model files could be shared with GGUF-compatible runtimes. However, its core distribution model embeds the weights inside a single executable, and community users say this bundling makes models hard to reuse beyond a single binary. Missing for 10: documentation on extracting or pointing other runtimes at a llamafile's embedded weights, explicit guidance on loading external GGUF files without re-downloading, any description of cache locations or cache sharing, and hands-on confirmation of cross-runtime reuse.
